verdict.rationale: a-Shell is a Unix-like terminal on iOS, a developer tool where an AI coding-agent workflow is a plausible axis. The evidence shows only local shell, language runtimes, Vim, package installs and Apple Shortcuts automation. Nothing shows issue assignment to an AI agent or automatic pull-request creation.

support.subject: As an ai-native user, I can assign an issue to an AI coding agent and receive a ready-to-review pull request
